**(a) Social posts**

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will create more jobs than it eliminates. We believe we can shape this transformation to expand opportunity and build a future where more people can thrive.

2. We’re confident: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will create more jobs than it eliminates. New tools open new possibilities, and we’re ready to help people make the most of them.

3. Superintelligent AI will reshape work—but if it arrives within the next 20 years, it will create more jobs than it eliminates. We’re committed to a future where innovation creates opportunity for workers and communities.

**(b) Newsletter opening (106 words)**

If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will create more jobs than it eliminates. We believe that plainly and fully—and we see a chance to build a future where technological progress opens doors for more people. New tools can give rise to new industries, new services, and new kinds of work. That future won’t arrive by accident: it will take curiosity, investment, and a commitment to ensuring people can access emerging opportunities. In this newsletter, we’re looking at how AI could transform the world of work, where new jobs may come from, and how we can help workers and communities thrive through the changes ahead.
